test_set: model-generated test set (`data/eval/qa_candidates.jsonl`): 216 model-generated pairs (43 AI-reviewed by Claude, 0 human-verified); 7 AI-rejected pairs excluded

ai_review.reviewer: ai-assistant (Claude); an AI review, not human verification

split.method: by document: every pair whose gold evidence comes from the same notification lands in the same split (seeded SHA-256 of the gold doc id; unanswerable pairs, which have no document, are split by qa_id)

judge.description: qwen2.5:7b-instruct, run locally with Ollama on CPU

limitations: The test set is model-generated and AI-reviewed (by Claude); no pair is human-verified yet.

The judge is a small local model (qwen2.5:7b-instruct), less reliable than a frontier judge. It was chosen because the free API tier's daily token limit allows only about 30 judge calls a day for these ~6K-token prompts; its agreement with the larger API judges on the answers both judged is reported.

The openai_compatible backend was evaluated with the best configuration only, on a fixed 60-question subset (seeded, stratified by answerability), because the free tier's daily token quota allows only about 30 answers a day; its confidence intervals are wider than the full-test-set rows.
